text: There is an atmosphere of anticipation as I observe the world through glass, peering into a room dedicated to R+D—research and development. The modern, almost sterile surroundings invite contemplation on innovation and the essence of progress. I feel both curiosity and a slight distance, as if pausing on the threshold of new knowledge, contemplating the impact of human ingenuity. The design—a dance between order and creativity—awakens a sense of wonder about what possibilities await just beyond these transparent barriers.
